hero.s1_teks: Evernight unifies compile-time safety with ergonomic syntax. Built for predictable execution, zero-cost abstractions, and effortless concurrency.
hero.s2_teks: Keywords like jika, selama, fungsi, and kembali make code feel natural — as easy as Python, as powerful as C++, no semicolons.
hero.s3_teks: Compiles to bytecode and runs on our own VM — lightweight, fast, and fully self-contained with zero external dependencies.
hero.s4_teks: 7 ready-to-use modules: console, string, math, list, dict, system, and utilities — all built in, no extra packages.
hero.s5_teks: Formatter, linter, package manager, LSP, and VS Code extension — everything you need to be productive from line one.
banner.teks: An Indonesian programming language — as easy as Python, as powerful as C++. » Learn more
unduh.sub: Standalone binary for Windows x64 — no dependencies, ready in seconds.
unduh.cepat_desc: Extract the ZIP and run install.cmd for automatic setup.
unduh.wizard_desc: Step-by-step GUI installer with folder selection and .eve file association.
unduh.sumber: Release sources are also available on GitHub
